findings.text: §5 asserts `refine-trigger-comment-dims` and `refine-trigger-comment-chars` have "only reader … that trigger call at `workers.py:7304`", but `tests/standard_names/fanout/test_trigger_dims_align_with_review.py` reads `refine_trigger_comment_dims` in three tests (`test_default_trigger_dims_subset_of_review_dims`, `test_loaded_settings_trigger_dims_subset_of_review_dims`, `test_default_trigger_dims_nonempty`), so retiring the field also breaks those tests; the "only reader" clause is the evidence the retirement rests on and it is false as written
